system.description:
You may use this skill if your subclass is War Priest, Devotee/Prayer Hand, or Magical Girl.

Heal a target other then you for [[/r (@attributes.pow.value*2)+ @battle-status.power.restoration.total]]{[(Base POW) × 2 + (Recovery)]} .

A feat that uses healing magic by offering prayers. The feeling of thinking of your wounded and fallen comrades will become a miracle of healing, giving them courage and hope.
